rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose choice for a bill or invoice, especially in casual conversation.

example.english: The shop still hasn't given me the invoice.
example.jyutping: gaan1 pou3 tau2 zung6 mei6 bei2 ngo5 zoeng1 daan1

rows.note: Use this for the formal business document specifying the goods or services and amount due.

example.english: The supplier will send us the formal invoice at the end of the month.
example.traditional: 供應商會喺月底寄正式發票畀我哋。
example.jyutping: gung1 jing3 soeng1 wui5 hai2 jyut6 dai2 gei3 zing3 sik1 faat3 piu3 bei2 ngo5 dei6
